# GoodBiz Apparels

> Garment manufacturer and exporter in India. Supplies importers, brands and retailers with men's, women's and kids' clothing, either from ready stock or made to the buyer's design, size chart, fabric and GSM. 38 product lines, each with an 8 digit HSN code.

## How to buy
- [Ready stock garments](https://www.YOUR-DOMAIN.com/ready-stock-garments/): finished pieces, faster dispatch
- [Made to order / private label](https://www.YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-label-clothing-manufacturer/): your design, size chart and GSM, sample before bulk
- [Send an enquiry](https://www.YOUR-DOMAIN.com/contact/)
